claim_tested: DBMF implementation-level return evidence should exceed a managed-futures peer benchmark, not merely cash, with persistence across fixed calendar years and two first-party since-inception snapshots.
notes: Fund returns are first-party published NAV returns net of fund fees. SG CTA is an index benchmark and is not directly investable; this discriminator tests implementation edge relative to peer strategy exposure, not realizable allocator excess after separate benchmark implementation costs.
